description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：100。

- 默认值：10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

- Maximum value: 100

- Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

description.zh: 端口列表 ID。N 的取值范围：0~100。
description.en: The ID of the port list. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

description.zh: 端口列表的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://、https://、com.aliyun和com.alibabacloud开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the port list. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http\://, https\://, com.aliyun, or com.alibabacloud. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~2679950~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2679950~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。您可以调用[ListResourceGroups](~~2716558~~)查询资源组列表。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group. If you specify this parameter to query resources, up to 1,000 resources that belong to the specified resource group can be returned in the response. You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~2716558~~) operation to query the most recent resource group list.

> A default resource group is not supported.

description.zh: 端口列表绑定的标签数组。
description.en: The tags that are added to the port list.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用[ListTagResources](~~110425~~)接口进行查询。
description.en:
The key of tag N. Valid values: 1 to 20.

If you specify a single tag to query resources, up to 1,000 resources to which the tag is added are returned. If you specify multiple tags to query resources, up to 1,000 resources to which all specified tags are added are returned. To query more than 1,000 resources that have specified tags added, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-port-range-lists --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token 727d41872117f2816343eeb432fbc5bfd21dc824589d2a4be0b5e8707e68181f --max-results 10 --port-range-list-name PortRangeListNameSample --port-range-list-id prl-2ze97430000 --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=value_for_PortRangeList Key=key_for_PortRangeList --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribePortRangeLists --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key_for_PortRangeList --NextToken 727d41872117f2816343eeb432fbc5bfd21dc824589d2a4be0b5e8707e68181f --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --PortRangeListId.1 'prl-2ze97430000' --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value value_for_PortRangeList --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PortRangeListName PortRangeListNameSample
